nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
## 运镜版粘土

**提示词模板**

Claymation style, stop motion clay, miniature clay diorama of a traditional Chinese garden courtyard. A small, handcrafted clay set featuring a wooden pavilion with carved lattice windows, blooming pink cherry blossom trees made of layered clay petals, lush green clay vines climbing the walls, stone pathways winding through the garden, and a tiny ornamental rock garden. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the clay leaves, casting soft dappled shadows on the textured ground. Cinematic lighting, bright vivid colors, shallow depth of field, handcrafted clay details, visible fingerprints, soft clay textures.

角色：

女孩： Hand-sculpted clay character, cute girl, clay animation style. Long brown hair formed into two braided buns, adorned with tiny pink clay flowers. Big brown eyes, rosy cheeks, a bright sweet smile sculpted from clay. Wearing a cream-white clay Hanfu with floral embroidery, a red and orange decorative waist sash. Standing posture, playful and cute, with a slightly rounded, stylized form.
男孩： Hand-sculpted clay character, cute boy, clay animation style. Dark brown short clay hair with a hair bun on top, a small wooden hairpin with a green leaf detail. Big clear dark eyes, a gentle warm smile. Wearing a cream-white clay Hanfu robe with cloud embroidery and a dark brown waist sash. Standing posture, elegant and gentle, with a soft, rounded clay appearance.
分镜描述：

全景俯拍 (2秒)：
Clay diorama view, panoramic aerial view of the miniature clay garden courtyard. Pink cherry blossoms are sculpted from clay in full bloom, like soft clouds. Stone pathways wind towards the wooden pavilion with exquisite carved lattice windows. The boy and girl clay figures stand side by side in the center of the courtyard, surrounded by flocks of small clay butterflies fluttering their wings, all made with hand-shaped clay details.
中景 (3秒)：
Medium shot focusing on the upper body of the clay girl. She points at the butterflies in the air, extending her hand to catch one. She calls out softly: “哥哥，快看！蝴蝶！” The clay figure has a childlike innocent smile, with visible clay texture on her face and hair.
近景 (3秒)：
Close-up of the boy’s clay face and upper body. The boy looks towards the girl, gently flicks the clay butterfly with his finger, and says softly: “来！送给你。” The close-up shows the hand-sculpted details of his eyes, nose, and the soft smile, with subtle clay fingerprints on his skin.
特写 (2秒)：
Extreme close-up shot of the clay butterfly resting on the girl’s hand. The butterfly’s wings are made of layered clay with visible textures. The girl looks up at the boy with eyes full of gratitude and joy, whispering: “谢谢哥哥。” The focus is on the detailed clay work of the butterfly and the girl’s hand.
镜头语言：

黏土微缩模型全景建立手工感与空间感，展示庭院全貌。
中景聚焦人物上半身，突出女孩的惊喜神态与黏土质感。
近景特写捕捉男孩的温柔动作，强化情感互动与手工细节。
特写镜头聚焦黏土蝴蝶细节，增强画面生动性与材质感。
镜头运动从俯拍→中景→近景→特写的递进，展现故事发展。
光影运用：暖光透过黏土樱花树洒落，在人物和蝴蝶上形成柔和光斑，营造温馨、手工感的氛围。

**全局提示词**

Claymation style, stop motion clay, handcrafted clay diorama, miniature set, soft clay textures, visible fingerprints, rounded stylized proportions, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, warm storybook tone, nostalgic stop-motion animation aesthetic.

风格：GoldenAgeComic复古漫画质感，融合水墨古风仙侠，淡雅留白。画面带硬朗漫画线条、高饱和色彩、网点印刷纹理，戏剧性。
场景：青瓦白墙古院（网点黑白灰），百年樱花满枝（网点高饱和粉白花瓣，动态线条），花瓣纷飞（漫画动态），薄雾轻笼（网点渐变），天光柔和（高对比度光影）。
女子：墨发半挽，银质发饰（锐利漫画笔触），浅蓝飘带（高饱和浅蓝），水滴玉坠（高饱和绿色）。白蓝渐变仙裙（硬朗漫画线条），腰系深蓝带（高饱和绿色），衣袂飘逸（漫画夸张飘动），清冷温婉（漫画戏剧性表情）。
男子：墨发高束，银冠（锐利漫画线条），白蓝渐变仙袍（硬朗云纹），黑带玉饰（高饱和黑绿），黑靴（硬朗线条），清隽出尘（漫画夸张古风造型）。

分镜 1（全景，0-2秒）
镜头：固定全景，不动。
画面：GoldenAgeComic漫画开场，水墨+网点。古院樱花如云（网点高饱和花瓣），两人并肩树下（漫画动态飘动衣袂），画面静谧带网点背景。
音效：风声+古风弦乐，加入复古漫画对话框音效（如“嗖”声）。

分镜 2（中景，2-10秒）
镜头：固定中景，极轻微推近。
画面：女子侧身拈网点樱瓣（高饱和色彩），抬眸含笑（漫画夸张温柔）；男子垂眸看花，点头回应（硬朗眼神）。衣袖交叠（漫画夸张褶皱），背景薄雾+网点樱花。
台词（女子）：“仙君，凡间的樱花开得真好，这春天没白来。”（漫画复古配音，夸张语调）
台词（男子）：“花期虽短，添些景色便好。”（同上，沉稳语调）

## 运镜蝴蝶

**提示词模板**

[场景] Traditional Chinese garden courtyard with a wooden pavilion featuring carved lattice windows, blooming pink cherry blossom trees, lush green vines climbing the walls, stone pathways winding through the garden, and a small ornamental rock garden. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the leaves, casting soft dappled shadows on the ground. Cinematic lighting, bright and vivid colors, 3D CG render, high detail.

[角色]

女孩：1 cute girl, 3D animation style, CG render. Long brown hair tied in two braided buns adorned with pink flowers, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks, bright sweet smile, wearing a cream white Hanfu with floral embroidery, red and orange decorative waist sash. Standing posture, playful and cute.
男孩：1 cute boy, 3D animation style, CG render. Dark brown short hair with a hair bun on top, wooden hairpin with a small green leaf, big clear dark eyes, gentle warm smile, wearing a cream white Hanfu robe with cloud embroidery and a dark brown waist sash. Standing posture, elegant and gentle.
分镜 1 (全景 2秒) 俯拍全景。庭院全景，樱花树盛放，石板小径通向木制雕花门窗，两人并肩站立在庭院中央，女孩突然指向空中，眼中闪烁着惊喜的光芒。

分镜 2 (中景 3秒) 镜头切换半身中景。一只色彩斑斓的蝴蝶从女孩指尖飞过，她踮起脚尖，伸出手掌想要捕捉，脸上露出孩童般的天真笑容，轻声呼唤：“哥哥，快看！”

分镜 3 (近景 3秒) 近景呈现男孩的面部与上半身。男孩循声望去，看到蝴蝶在女孩身边飞舞，他微笑着轻轻挥手，用手指轻轻一弹，蝴蝶便乖乖落在了女孩的手背上，他温柔地说：“送给你。”

分镜 4 (特写 2秒) 特写镜头。女孩的手背上停着蝴蝶，翅膀微微颤动，她小心翼翼地用指尖轻轻触碰，然后抬头望向男孩，眼中满是感激与喜悦，轻声说：“谢谢哥哥。”

[镜头语言]

全景俯拍：建立空间感，展示庭院全貌
半身中景：聚焦人物上半身与面部表情，突出女孩的惊喜神态
近景特写：捕捉男孩的温柔动作，强化情感互动
特写镜头：聚焦蝴蝶细节，增强画面生动性
镜头运动：从俯拍→中景→近景→特写的递进，展现故事发展
光影运用：暖光透过樱花树洒落，在人物和蝴蝶上形成柔和光斑，营造温馨氛围

**全局提示词**

3D animation style, CG render, Chinese 3D anime style, Disney Pixar style, Unreal Engine 5, cinematic lighting, bright and vivid colors, warm healing atmosphere, highly detailed, masterpiece, 8k resolution.
